scoreRationale.gameplay: Coil destruction and objective recovery gave meaningful progress, but I mostly bypassed enemies and lost both runs; sustained combat quality remains uncertain.
scoreRationale.presentation: Strong rainy teal/orange station atmosphere, wet reflections and coherent title/HUD; repeated blocky enemies and architecture remain visibly prototype-like.
scoreRationale.usability: Persistent controls, exact outside-reach prompts and paused map support recovery; collision and camera steering required repeated corrections.
scoreRationale.readability: Objectives and coil percentages are useful. Small typography, crowded overlapping cues, offscreen receiver markers and architectural occlusion made quick interpretation difficult.
scoreRationale.aaaReadiness: Playable slice with a clear loop, but these two losses and limited automation cannot certify polish, breadth or AAA readiness.

findings: Repeatedly stopping just outside receiver reach cost exposed time; precise distance prompts enabled correction, but image-space ring interpretation remained difficult.
Boss side approach gave a clear shot to coil1 in second run; close frontal view in first run exposed coils2/3 but hid coil1. This is observed access, not a general route recommendation.
Successful coil hits gave clear OFF and visual blackened-coil feedback. Shooting disabled/inert housing or scenery wasted rounds in first attempt.
Low health entering extraction was decisive in second run. I left most patrol enemies alive and did not establish whether a more combat-focused approach improves survival.
A look-only batch had unchanged heading at capture; right-mouse look fallback visibly turned the camera. Relative sensitivity and delayed capture made aim imperfect.
No page errors reported by driver; no inference of absence of other bugs.
